title: How are original bills of lading lodged back with the line so that a correction can go ahead?
content:
## Scope of application

This entry of the Bills of Lading and Transport Documents product applies when a correction of an issued transport document is requested on a document type whose tier requires the originals to be returned before an issued document is corrected. In that situation the originals still in circulation are lodged back with the line at the origin office, and the lodgement is recorded as one entry carrying the number of originals handed in.

## Who lodges the originals, and when

1. The originals are lodged by the shipper printed on the document, who alone can hand in the originals.
2. The lodgement takes place during a contact in which the shipper has the originals with it at the origin office.
3. The lodgement is taken from the documentation party holding the record only when that party is the printed shipper, meaning that its registered company name matches the shipper name printed on the document exactly, character for character.
4. Otherwise, the correction request waits for the shipper.

| Situation during the contact | Handling |
|---|---|
| Documentation party is the printed shipper (exact, character-for-character name match) and has the originals at the origin office | The lodgement is taken |
| Documentation party's registered company name differs from the printed shipper name in any character | The correction request waits for the shipper |

## Business effect

One lodgement records originals of one set as handed in at the origin office on the current date, and the count of originals still in circulation on the document goes down by the number lodged. Nothing is charged. The customer can afterwards see the lodgement in the documentation history and the reduced number of originals outstanding.

## How it is invoked

return_originals_for_correction_b9bd03b3 is a customer-side tool. It must first be unlocked and handed over, to be run by the customer themselves, here the printed shipper in its role as documentation party.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| bl_id | Reference number of the transport document whose originals are lodged, as returned by the transport document lookup for the bill of lading number quoted | Id text |
| bl_set_sequence | The set of originals the lodged originals belong to: 1 for the first set issued, 2 for a replacement or switch set | Whole number, no decimals |
| originals_count | How many original documents are lodged in this call | Whole number of 1 or more, no decimals |

## Return

A confirmation sentence naming the documentation entry reference (an opaque text id beginning "bse_"), the transport document reference, the set number and the number of originals lodged at the origin office. The appearance of that sentence is the success signal; the lodgement is then visible in the documentation history.

## Points of judgement

- **Question:** A freight forwarder is the documentation party, but the shipper printed on the document is its supplier. Can the forwarder hand in the originals? **Answer:** No. The lodgement is taken from the documentation party only when it is the printed shipper; here the correction request waits for the shipper.
- **Question:** The registered company name and the printed shipper name differ only by a punctuation mark. **Answer:** The match must be exact, character for character, so the names do not match and the request waits for the shipper.
